purpose: Teach: 盧/洲/卿/大王/艦長/豪州/ムスリム/キリスト教徒

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、韓国元大統領盧氏の政策研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on the political policies of former Korean President Roh, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Direct but not interrogative. Steady, deliberate pace. The careful attention of a teacher who has read the work and wants to hear the student's own framing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、満洲、つまり旧満洲国洲の歴史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the history of Manchuria—the former Manchukuo state.
lines.style: Clear and measured. Matter-of-fact delivery without defensiveness. Slight pause before the clarification, like she's being precise. Direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 英国貴族の卿、つまり卿位の歴史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered the history of English peerage—the system of noble titles, I see.
lines.style: Thoughtful, gently probing. Slight rise at the end, inviting expansion. Patient silence underneath. The tone of someone tracking the thread of a student's thinking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、古代の大王、つまり大王制の歴史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the history of ancient kingship—the system of monarchical rule.
lines.style: Steady and precise. Each phrase lands without apology. Quiet confidence. The tone of someone who has done the work and knows what she's saying.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦艦の艦長の役割研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your study of the role of a battleship captain's command responsibilities—
lines.style: Reflective pause before speaking. Gently exploratory. The cadence of connecting ideas. Trailing slightly upward, opening space for the student's response.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、豪州、つまりオーストラリアの先住民研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I researched the history of Australia's Indigenous peoples.
lines.style: Clear assertion. No hesitation. Respectful register when naming the subject. Grounded, matter-of-fact. The delivery of someone who chose this carefully.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ムスリム共同体の社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You addressed the sociology of Muslim communities in your work.
lines.style: Respectful, observant tone. Genuine curiosity without presumption. Warm but formal. The careful attention teachers bring to subjects that matter beyond the classroom.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、初期キリスト教徒の歴史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote on the history of early Christians.
lines.style: Direct and complete. No trailing off. Confident close to the exchange. The tone of someone who has said what she came to say and is ready to move forward.
